title: AuthinfoUser cert-bypass asymmetry: Authenticating vs Active paths use different authenticated_user format
description: In dispatch.rs, cert-store bypass stores cert_user.to_string() (preserving cert_store case), while trusted-issuer bypass stores cn.to_lowercase(). A future caller comparing authenticated_user values across sessions or auth methods will get case-sensitive mismatches. The policy should be unified and documented — pick lowercase-always or preserve-case-always.
